name: Zalando
summary: Zalando's 'How we hire' page describes a first call with a Talent Acquisition Partner (about 15 to 45 minutes, on motivation, salary expectations and next steps), a call with the hiring manager, a case study or challenge for some roles, and final interviews of three to five sessions of 45 to 60 minutes. For software engineers it lists a coding interview, a system design interview and a general technical interview, over roughly two to three weeks. Zalando suggests the STAR method for experience questions and the REACTO approach for coding.
rounds: Call with a Talent Acquisition Partner: motivation, salary expectations and next steps
Interview with the hiring manager about your experience and the role
Case study or challenge for some roles (marketing, product, design)
Final interviews: three to five sessions, each about 45 to 60 minutes
For engineers: coding, system design and a general technical interview

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to win over a stakeholder who didn't agree with you.
covers: How you understood their view and made your case

questions.text: Tell me about a decision you made using data that surprised you.
covers: What you decided and the result

questions.text: Tell me about a time you delivered under a tight deadline.
covers: The deadline and why it was tight

questions.text: Tell me about something you'd do differently in a past project.
covers: Why it wasn't the best choice

questions.text: How would you design a system that shows customers whether an item in their size is in stock, across warehouses and partner shops?
covers: Stock sources and how often they update
Caching for speed and staying correct

questions.text: How would you reduce the number of returns for shoes bought online?
covers: Why people return: size, fit, look
Size advice, better photos and reviews
Measuring the effect on returns and sales

questions.text: Walk me through solving a coding problem: repeat it, give examples, set an approach, code, test and optimise.
How would you measure whether a new recommendation carousel is working?
covers: An A/B test and how long to run it
What you'd do if results are mixed

questions.text: How would you plan a seasonal sale campaign across several countries?
covers: Measuring results and learning for next time

questions.text: Explain a technical trade-off you made recently to a non-technical colleague.
Why do you want to work at Zalando?
covers: Something specific about Zalando's customers, fashion or technology
How your skills fit the role

questions.text: What questions do you have about the team and how it works?
covers: How the team plans its work
What success looks like in the first months

tips: Zalando suggests the STAR method for experience questions: situation, task, action, result.
For coding, practise the REACTO approach Zalando describes: repeat, examples, approach, code, test, optimise.
Apply through Zalando's online form; it says recruiters write from official addresses and never ask for payment.
Zalando's jobs blog has a prep guide for many roles; read the one for yours.
